findings.wrap deposit visibility: PUBLIC (plain uint256 argument, visible in calldata)
findings.operator blast radius: TOTAL - no allowance function exists; an operator may move the entire confidential balance and may unwrap it to any address until `until` expires
findings.aggregate reservations: provider reservations remain encrypted handles; only a deliberate publish crosses the boundary
findings.unwrap amount visibility: PUBLIC and IRREVERSIBLE - _unwrap calls allowPublicDecryption on the burn amount; finalizeUnwrap writes the plaintext into an event
